blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: tentative distance — Best known cost to an unsettled vertex.
settled — Vertex whose shortest distance has been finalised.
relaxation — Improve a neighbour's distance via the current vertex.
predecessor — Previous vertex on the best-known route.
non-negative weight — Edge cost of zero or greater.

blocks.title: Initialise from the start
blocks.text: Distance(A)=0, all others infinity. Relax A's edges to set B=4 and C=2.

blocks.title: Always choose smallest tentative distance
blocks.text: C=2 settles before B=4. Through C, B improves to 3.

blocks.title: Keep updating neighbours
blocks.text: Settling B changes D from 10 to 8; settling D changes E from 12 to 10.

blocks.title: Reconstruct from predecessors
blocks.text: E←D←B←C←A. Reverse these arrows for A→C→B→D→E, total distance 10.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict the next state
blocks.text: P gives tentative Q=3 and R=7.
